notes.title: Bugfix update v1.0.2 is live
notes.notes:
Fixed few bugs:

 Sometimes in Windows game window appeared outside the screen with resolution height less than 768
 Increased gamepad D-Pad and axis sensitivity
 Now after game quit without finishing level your time and death count stores to the savefile
 Not handling gamepad events is it's not configured
